name: zsnd_stream_request_match_group_predicate
description: zSndStreamRequest::MatchGroupPredicate returns zero when an active stream request belongs to the queried group and nonzero otherwise.
known_limits: tier S verification is tracked separately by the zsnd_stream_request_match_group_predicate VC manifest.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a5220 validates loading request->group from offset 0x38, comparing it with EDX, returning zero for a matching group, and returning one for a different group.

The native smoke verifies zSndGroup::QueueStreamRequest rejects a second request for a playSolo group when the active list already contains a request for that group, which depends on zArchiveList_FindPayloadByPredicate stopping on this predicate's zero-valued match.
